import seaborn as sns

# Add labels and title

plt.ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Top 10 Most Common Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=15)

plt.yticks(fontsize=10)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Process data to get the count of dogs by breed
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(x=breed_counts.values, y=breed_counts.index, palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Number of Registered Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Top 10 Most Common Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=15)
plt.xticks(fontsize=10)
plt.yticks(fontsize=10)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
